ED_Title: Request for an advisory opinion of the International Court of Justice on the legal consequences of the separation of the Chagos Archipelago from Mauritius in 1965
ED_DecisionText: At its 115th plenary meeting, on 4 September 2026, the General Assembly decided to include the item entitled “Request for an advisory opinion of the International Court of Justice on the legal consequences of the separation of the Chagos Archipelago from Mauritius in 1965” in the draft agenda of the eighty-first session.
ED_Disclaimer: The final text of this decision will be contained in document A/80/49 (Vol. III) after editorial review.
